headline: Get clear on marketing words, A to Z.
body: This free guide explains 102 internet marketing terms in plain English, from A to Z, to help you make sense of it all.
caption: Ever feel like marketing speak is a secret language? You're not alone! For creators, freelancers, and small online sellers, understanding common marketing terms can feel like a big hurdle. Our free guide, 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary,' breaks down 102 essential terms, A to Z, into simple, everyday language. No more guessing what 'SEO' or 'CTR' means.
